summary.text: Dave Rogers is a Democratic state representative from the 24th Middlesex District who has served since January 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he chairs the Joint Committee on Higher Education.

paragraphs.text: Dave Rogers was born in Pennsylvania, according to Ballotpedia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Ithaca College and a law degree from American University.
His professional experience includes working as a business attorney handling contracts and negotiations.
Rogers assumed office in the Massachusetts House on January 2, 2013.
For 2025-2026 he chaired the Higher Education Joint Committee, and earlier he chaired the Cannabis Policy Joint Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
